files.html:
0.2.3 Change Log

  • Added world terrain capture to Battle Presentation, allowing captured scenes to be used as background images.
  • Added particle effects to Battle Presentation and improved its UI.
  • Added customizable facing directions before Trainer Battles begin.
  • Fixed various bugs in the battle engine.
  • Fixed a bug with the Cobblemon trading GUI in Poké Mart.
